_about: Every assumption the audit scripts use. Change a value here and re-run `make evidence` to see its effect on the report. Unit prices approximate us-east-1 on-demand list prices for Linux and Aurora PostgreSQL; a real engagement reads them from the AWS Price List API.

unit_prices.aurora_postgresql_price_source: db.r5 on-demand rates for Aurora PostgreSQL (Aurora Standard) match the AWS Price List API offer file for AmazonRDS in us-east-1, as do Aurora storage (0.10 per GB-month) and I/O (0.20 per million requests), which the rightsizing does not change.

compute_savings_plan.discount_source: Observed on the existing Compute Savings Plan: 1 - commitment / on-demand equivalent covered.

rds_reserved_instances.discount_source: Planning figure, below typical published 1-year No Upfront rates for db.r5 Aurora PostgreSQL. Confirm with the Price List API before purchase.

rightsize-ec2.why: Instance type change needs a rolling replacement and a load test on memory headroom.

rightsize-rds-prod.why: Resize the reader, fail over to it, then resize the old writer; schedule it in a maintenance window after a load test.

rightsize-rds-staging.why: Staging only; the writer restarts during the class change, and a short outage is acceptable.

schedule-staging.why: Instance Scheduler or an EventBridge schedule; staging is idle outside working hours.

unattached-ebs.why: Snapshot each volume first, then delete; the snapshot is the rollback.

gp2-to-gp3.why: Elastic Volumes change the type online, with no detach and no downtime.

old-snapshots.why: Only snapshots older than the threshold, not used by an AMI and without a retention tag.

idle-eip.why: Release after confirming no DNS record or allow list points at the address.

idle-load-balancers.why: No requests in 14 days; delete after checking DNS.

idle-instances.why: No owner tag and about 1% CPU; stop, wait one week for a claim, then terminate.

log-retention.why: One setting per log group; export anything under a compliance hold first.

debug-logging.why: Needs an application config change and a release of order-api.

s3-lifecycle.why: One lifecycle rule; reads of older logs are rare and remain immediate in Glacier Instant Retrieval.

nat-consolidation.why: Route table changes in staging; an AZ outage would cut staging egress, which is acceptable.

compute-savings-plan.why: A one-year commitment; buy it after rightsizing so it does not lock in oversized usage.

rds-reserved-instances.why: A one-year commitment; buy it after the orders-db resize.
